content:
alex: Evening handoff — I'm on until 03:00 PT. Quick status on postmortem follow-ups from yesterday's KV-cache spike:
- Open items: (1) KV cache TTL fix deployment (PR #482), (2) canary for model-fallback routing, (3) alert threshold tuning.
I'll list owners and verification steps. /cc @priya @jin

priya: Thanks — I merged #482 and pinned a canary. Deploy scheduled for 21:15 PT. I'll watch latency for first 30m. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy started: PR #482 -> prod-canary (nodes: gpu-pool-a). build 2026.03.17-21:15

jin: I'll run the synthetic load test after canary is green. Script:
```
scripts/load-test --profile kv-cache --qps 200 --duration 600
```
I'll post run summary.

sam: FYI: alert "kv_cache_miss_rate" left at 3m window — adjusted to 5m in staging but not prod. I'll patch rule in /infra/alerts tonight.

rebecca: Been looking at the trace sample, seems fallback routing spike correlates with model LB flapping. Ticket #1987 opened for LB backoff. Assigned to jin.

priya: Canary is green so far (21:28). No latency regression in traces. :white_check_mark:

jin: Load test done: 10% elevated miss rate at minute 4, then stabilized. Log excerpt:
```
[21:34:04] miss_rate=0.12 rtt=85ms
[21:34:40] miss_rate=0.07 rtt=82ms
```
I'll upload full logs to the incident ticket.

alex: Great. Sam — once you update alert rule, can you also add a suppression for the next hour during canary? Don't want noisy pages.

sam: Yep. Suppression set for 60m starting 21:20. Also patched prod alert to 5m window, threshold 0.15.

priya: Re: reopen — any reason to reopen the incident? I think fixes are in and canary looks fine, but we should keep monitoring overnight.

jin: Agreed. Recommend not reopening, but add follow-up eval: run end-to-end with diverse prompt lengths tomorrow. I can own that.

alex: OK — decision: incident stays closed. Postmortem actions tracked in #1987 with owners: priya (deploy), jin (load/e2e), sam (alerts), rebecca (lb). I'll leave a small note in the doc and ping oncall in 6h.

rebecca: Added owners+ETA: priya 21:30, jin 07:00, sam 22:00, rebecca 09:00. Linking doc: https://rwd.redwood/doc/1987/postmortem-actions

oncall-bot: Reminder: next handoff reminder in 2h.

priya: quick code-review ping for #486 (kv cache TTL unit test) — @alex can you glance when you have a sec?

alex: Will review before 22:00.

jin: Also, small FYI — if we see a second spike, flip fallback to smaller model pool using policy "fallback-small" (runbook step 4).

sam: Noted. I'll add an automated runbook step.

alex: Thanks team. I'll update the oncall slack post with final status and close this thread once the 30m monitor window passes.
